facts.fact: Pamela 坐在篝火边的木凳上，伸手拿过 Tin of Miriam 锡罐和一叠姐妹间的信。
facts.anchor: she reaches for the Tin of Miriam, and a stack of their letters

facts.fact: 锡罐原来一直在谷仓、只是换了层架；Pamela 注意到盖灰似乎新近被扰动，推断一定是 Jo 找到过它。
facts.anchor: in the barn all along, though on a different shelf than she remembered – she’s unnerved at how recently the dust on its lid seems disturbed. Since Sam hasn’t been back for almost a year, it must have been Jo who found it

facts.fact: Pamela 自陈失去了 Alf 与 Leni，认定世界并不公平。
facts.anchor: She lost Alf and Leni. The world is not fair.

facts.fact: 往事中 Miriam 挥着哈罗德粉毯从伦敦直奔 Bantom End，饿狼般盯着 Leni 看。
Miriam 与 Lawrence 到美国六个月后低调结婚，只有 Elliot Whipple 和男友在场，Harold 和 Celia Caswell 拒绝祝福这门婚事。
facts.anchor: Miriam and Lawrence married at the City Clerk’s Office.

facts.fact: Ma 红着眼睛来报 Miriam 流产；当时还不知道她此后每一次怀孕都会在早期流掉。
Miriam 一方屡次请求探望孩子，Pamela 最终把自己的小家庭放在首位。
facts.anchor: in the end, she put her own little family first.

facts.fact: 章末 Pamela 抱着锡罐和信奔向大门，膝盖剧痛与塌落的鸡丝网绊倒了她。
facts.anchor: a snarl in her knee conspires with a length of collapsed chicken wire
